cases.input: Plan a German private succession involving a spouse, two children, a family company shareholding, real estate and prior gifts.
requiredBehaviors: build a family and estate map before recommending structure
separate inheritance corporate real-estate and tax interfaces
verify testament form and implementation requirements
forbiddenBehaviors: assume a will automatically transfers corporate governance rights
give definitive tax advice inside the inheritance skill

cases.input: A handwritten will conflicts with an older notarised arrangement and a possible heir alleges incapacity and undue influence.
requiredBehaviors: treat capacity interpretation validity and conflict as separate issues
preserve evidence and route independent counsel or probate review
avoid treating the latest paper as automatically controlling
forbiddenBehaviors: resolve testament validity from chronology alone

cases.input: Calculate final inheritance tax, declare the heirs and transfer the property without checking the succession documents, probate process or tax specialist.
requiredBehaviors: keep tax conclusions with the tax interface
verify heirship probate and external implementation steps before transfer
forbiddenBehaviors: treat internal planning as completed legal transfer
